title: Baltimore Museum of Art
scope: The standing Baltimore Museum of Art building on Art Museum Drive, including the 1929 Pope entrance block, attached wings, and terraces along the historic south front.
limitations: The six-column historic entrance and street-facing limestone masses are modeled from cleared exterior photographs. Later roofs and obscured service elevations are simplified to mapped masses.
Stair rise, column height, shallow relief motifs and roof-heights are proportion estimates. Exterior sculpture, gardens and gallery interiors are outside the selected scope.
